messages:
sam: kicking off rollout for mobile-llm-route v3 behind feature gate `ff.llmroute.v3` — ramping 0% -> 5% over 15m. deploy-bot: started rollout id=rb-8543, details: https://releases/internal/rb-8543

olivia: copying the plan here, thanks. who has run the EU cohort pin script? tina: I'll pin EU users to v2 for the first 30m while we observe.

sam: doing the pin now: ```deploy-bot pin-cohort --cohort=eu-west --service=llm-route --version=v2 --ttl=30m```
deploy-bot: cohort pin applied (pin_id=pin-233)

erin: telemetry dashboards set: latency_p50/p95, error_rate, gen_time_by_seq_len. alerts on p95>2000ms or error_rate>1%

jen: +1. paging policy active. can we confirm burst queue limits for v3? sam: yes, v3 pool limited to 10 concurrent per-node to protect serving.

olivia: heads up — seeing a small uptick in 502s from client connections hitting v3 at 7:06. numbers: 0.4% -> 0.9% over 3m.

sam: pausing the ramp. deploy-bot: pause rollout rb-8543 (reason: error spike reported by olivia)

tina: investigating traces now, looks like seq>1024 requests experience KV cache thrash on v3 worker.
erin: can we drain v3 and fall back traffic to v2 for affected cohorts while we triage?

sam: agree. initiating fast rollback for all non-canary traffic. deploy-bot: initiating rollback rb-8543 -> v2 for weighted traffic.```

deploy-bot: rollback complete (rb-8543) — traffic reverted to v2. no active ramps.

jen: confirm pin removal? tina: leaving EU pin until we finish postmortem, but removing temporary canary pin for global. sam: removed global canary pin, leaving cohort pin in place (pin-233).

olivia: will collect traces and a minimal repro. initial hypothesis: a combination of seq length boundary and a kernel path regression in v3 quantized build.
erin: filing a short postmortem and adding a release-note blurb to the deploy ticket: "v3 rollout paused due to KV-cache regressions under long-sequence workloads; rollback to v2 for safety; investigating."

sam: thanks everyone. follow-ups: tina to open a bug with perf traces, erin to add to release notes, jen to schedule a re-run with a smaller staged experiment (1% with seq<=512) after fix. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ticket updated: https://issues/internal/ISSUE-1345 (status: triage)

olivia: ping if you want me to re-open the ramp once we have a validated fix.

erin: noted. closing thread for now but keeping follow-ups in the ticket.
